_readme: Every achievement in the game. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. id and displayName are always required, and `condition` must name a PrincesPalace.Domain.Content.AchievementCondition value (case-insensitive). THIS FILE IS THE ONLY SOURCE OF TRUTH for what achievements exist -- relics.json's `unlockedBy` is validated against the ids here at content-build time, so a relic can never be gated on an achievement that does not exist. `threshold` is what the condition compares against and its meaning depends on the condition (a level, a room count, a depth, a damage total); a counting condition with threshold 0 is rejected, because it would be earned by every brand-new profile the instant it loaded. `parameter` is the condition's subject when it has one -- today only DefeatSpecificBoss uses it, naming a boss enemy id. Achievement ids end up in save data the moment one is earned, so NEVER RENAME ONE after a save exists: the player loses whatever it gated.

achievements.description: Put down the thing that guards the first forest.
Reach step forty of a single descent.
Deal a million damage across every run.
